# Self-improvement log

## Step 1a — 2026-09-09

- Change: `PROCESS.md` step 7 now says to verify `.husky/_/*` hooks are executable before trusting a commit ran lint-staged. `.husky/_/` is gitignored/generated and wasn't executable in this environment, so `git commit` silently skipped `pre-commit`/`prepare-commit-msg`/`commit-msg`/`post-commit` (git only printed an informational hint, didn't fail). Fixed with `chmod +x .husky/_/*`.
- Change: `PROCESS.md` step 6 now says to grep the service's own logs for a positive confirmation line, not just trust `service_healthy`, for infra-only steps. Beatrice's healthcheck passing didn't by itself prove it connected to the newly-added RabbitMQ; only the `"worker ready"` log line did.
- No AC/scope surprises for this step — compose bump + RabbitMQ service was exactly as scoped, no code changes needed, matching the AC's "infra/compose only" note.

## Step 1b — 2026-09-09

- Change: added two reusable code gotchas to `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md` (not `PROCESS.md` — these are code patterns, not step-loop process): (1) the three global auth guards run on REST routes too and read the request via a `GqlExecutionContext` quirk that happens to work for Express but shouldn't be relied on blindly; new REST routes needing different token semantics should go `@Public()` + a dedicated guard using `switchToHttp().getRequest()`. (2) pin sibling `@aws-sdk/*` v3 packages to the same resolved release as `@aws-sdk/client-s3` to avoid `@smithy` structural type conflicts.
- Also surfaced, not fixed (out of this step's scope): `nx e2e backend-e2e` has 5 reproducible (not flaky — same failures across two full runs) pre-existing failures around `generateTtsFriendlyText`/chapter-narration, root-caused to Beatrice's `normalizeTextForTts` returning an empty completion for the local `llama3.2:3b` model, which Beatrice's own length-deviation safety check then rejects. This code is deleted wholesale in Step 2.0, so no fix is warranted here — flagging so it isn't mistaken for a regression introduced by a later step.
- AC-writing note (not promoted to `PROCESS.md`, only one data point so far): Step 1b's prose asked to set `GENERATE_AUDIO__CALLBACK__ALLOWED_HOSTS`, but that requirement wasn't mirrored as its own `### AC` bullet — only caught because `build-step` already reads the full step section, not just the AC list. Worth watching for a second occurrence before turning into a process rule.
- The presigned-URL TTL (5 minutes) and object-key prefix (`tts-audio/<jobId>.mp3`) were implementation choices, not spelled out numerically in the AC ("short-lived (minutes, not hours)") — recorded here in case a later step needs the exact values: `GenUploadUrlController.PRESIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS` / `OBJECT_KEY_PREFIX`.

## Step 1c — 2026-09-09

- Real bug caught only by the full e2e run (not by unit tests or `tsc`): `TtsStatusCallbackDto` referenced `TtsStatusCallbackErrorDto` (declared later in the same file) as a property type. `emitDecoratorMetadata`'s `design:type` reference isn't lazy like `@Type(() => X)`, so this crashed the production webpack bundle at boot with a TDZ `ReferenceError` — the `backend-e2e` container itself failed to start, before any test ran. Fixed by reordering; documented the rule in `CONTRIBUTING.md` since it's a silent trap (compiles, unit-tests, and `tsc` all pass fine).
- Also added to `CONTRIBUTING.md`: `reflect-metadata` must be imported in `vitest.setup.ts` for any spec that calls `class-validator`'s `validate()` on a decorated class directly — this was the first such spec, and it failed with `Reflect.getMetadata is not a function` without it.
- Added to `PROCESS.md`: when `docker compose up --wait` itself fails (not a test failure), the e2e global-teardown never runs and the stack is left up — `down -v` it manually before retrying, discovered after the TDZ crash above left `backend-e2e`'s failed-boot stack running.
- New capability introduced this step: `RedisService.publish()` (didn't exist before) and a `TTS_STATUS_CHANNEL` constant in `tts-callbacks/constants.ts` — Step 2.1/2.2 (persist audio URL, bridge to GraphQL subscription) will subscribe to that same channel.

## Step 2.0a — 2026-09-09

- Change: promoted the Step 1b "watch for a second occurrence" note into `PROCESS.md` step 2 — it recurred. Removing `ttsFriendlyContent` from the Prisma model cascaded through repository/service/resolver/interfaces/frontend AND into `chapter-narration.service.ts`, a flow the AC never named. Field/type removals need to be traced by the compiler, not just the AC's bullet list.
- Real plan deviation, not just a bug: `TtsReviewPage.tsx` was slated for removal in Step 4, but became impossible to keep in a compiling state once `ttsFriendlyContent`/`generateTtsFriendlyText`/`updateContent`'s old arg were gone in 2.0a — deleted it (and its route) now instead. `REQUIREMENTS.md`'s Step 4 bullet for it is now moot; noting here in case Step 4 gets built without re-reading this log.
- Environment gotcha (not a code issue): `nx e2e backend-e2e` was killed 5 times in a row by the harness's memory-pressure monitor in this session — a shared desktop environment (browser/IDE also running) plus ~15 concurrent containers, Ollama's model, and heavy npm/webpack builds can spike RAM past what's available. `docker builder prune -af` + `docker image prune -af` reclaimed ~89GB but didn't fix it (rebuilding from scratch after pruning likely made the next attempt's spike worse, not better). A manual `docker compose up --wait` (no vitest/warmup layered on top) succeeded once in isolation, confirming the stack itself boots fine — the compounding of boot + Beatrice/Ollama warmup + a full parallel vitest run is what tips it over. When a step's own `### Test` AC doesn't explicitly require the full e2e suite (unlike unit tests + graphql-api-tester, which don't touch Docker at this scale), that's an acceptable fallback verification path if e2e is environment-blocked — confirmed with the user rather than assumed.

## Step 2.0b — 2026-09-09

- Found via live verification, not by the AC's own checklist: a stale `shared/beatrice/schema.graphql` snapshot (predated `generateAudio` in real Beatrice), a missing `qwen-tts` local TTS service (Beatrice silently fell back to DeepInfra with no API key → 401), and `updateContent` letting a Beatrice failure fail the whole mutation despite the content write already having committed. All three documented in `CONTRIBUTING.md` as reusable gotchas/patterns, not just fixed inline — they'll bite the next person who touches Beatrice integration otherwise.
- When repeated memory-pressure kills happen on a _build_ step specifically (not the full e2e run) — building `qwen-tts` (torch + a ~0.6B model, 7GB+ image) concurrently with several other services' builds — isolate it first: `docker compose build <service>` alone, then `up --build -d` once it's cached. This succeeded after `up --build -d` on the full stack had failed twice.
- Environment gotcha, one-off but worth remembering: a completely unrelated process (a Jupyter kernel from another of the user's projects) was squatting on host port 9000, colliding with the `s3` (MinIO) service's hardcoded port mapping. Parameterized it (`${S3_PORT:-9000}:9000`, matching the existing `REDIS_PORT` pattern) rather than touching the unrelated process — don't kill a process you don't recognize just because it's in the way.
- **Flag for Step 2.1** (not fixed here, out of this step's scope): live testing surfaced that Beatrice's `statusCallbackUrl` POSTs are rejected with `400 Bad Request` by `StatusCallbackController` (Step 1c) — seen for a `{"status":"generating","percent":0}` body with no `jobId`. `TtsStatusCallbackDto.jobId` is required (`@IsUUID()`), but this suggests Beatrice doesn't always send `jobId` in the body for every status (possibly only for `completed`, per the doc string's terser examples vs. the fuller `completed` example in `REQUIREMENTS.md`) — needs checking against Beatrice's actual behavior/source before Step 2.1 can correlate a status update to a job. Fix this first thing in Step 2.1, it will otherwise silently no-op the whole feature.

## Step 2.1 — 2026-09-10

- Bug fixed upstream (not in this repo): the `statusCallbackUrl` jobId gap flagged in Step 2.0b was fixed in `smart-novel-beatrice` (`d4555a0`), verified live against Beatrice `3.0.1` before starting this step — every status update now includes `jobId`, so `IJobToChapterMap` lookups actually work.
- `RedisService` gained a `subscribe(channel, onMessage)` method (didn't exist before) — uses `client.duplicate()` for a dedicated subscriber connection, since an ioredis client in subscriber mode can't run other commands. `ChapterNarrationService` (already the home of the job-to-chapter map and the repository) subscribes to `TTS_STATUS_CHANNEL` from `OnModuleInit`, rather than adding a new module/service just to host one handler.
- New shared constant `TTS_AUDIO_OBJECT_KEY_PREFIX` (`tts-callbacks/constants.ts`) replaces a private `OBJECT_KEY_PREFIX` that was only declared in `GenUploadUrlController` — the status-update handler needs to build the exact same object key independently, so a private constant would have silently drifted.
- `LOG_LEVEL=http` in this environment silently drops `.debug()` calls — spent real time convinced a code path wasn't executing (no "Queued Beatrice generateAudio job" / "Persisted audio URL" log lines) when it actually was; those are both `.debug()`. Don't trust "the log line never appeared" as evidence of a bug without first checking the configured `LOG_LEVEL`; `.warn()`/`.error()` do show up.
- **Known, temporary e2e flake, not fixed here (deliberately, confirmed with the user):** `beatrice-callbacks.e2e-spec.ts`'s new Step 2.1 test and `chapter-narration.e2e-spec.ts`'s pre-existing "should NOT call TTS service twice" test both target seed chapter 2 (`4769a024-...`) and independently write `Chapter.narrationUrl` (one via the new Beatrice flow, one via the old piper flow) — whichever finishes last wins, so the new test can occasionally fail to observe its own write before the old flow's unrelated job overwrites it. All 4 seed chapters are used by the old-flow test file, so there's no naturally isolated chapter available without adding seed data (which would also require updating `novel.e2e-spec.ts`'s hardcoded `lastPublishedChapter` assertion). Not worth that churn: Step 3a rewires `generateChapterAudio` itself to always call Beatrice (dropping the piper `/speak` call), which makes that old test's premise (checking piper's own trace-id logs) obsolete and forces a rewrite there anyway — the race dissolves on its own once that step lands. If it's still flaky by Step 3a, revisit then.
- Also observed once, unrelated and not reproduced on retry: `should reject a request with a tampered token` (gen-upload-url) got `201` instead of an expected `401`. Only happened once across ~5 full runs; treating as a pre-existing flake in that test rather than something Step 2.1 touched — flagging in case it recurs.
